fit_reason: Private seller listing a whole aluminum fishing boat with outboard on its trailer.
findings: Painted aluminum hull sides look clean with decent gloss in all side shots
Light water spotting and faint streaking on the white hull side panels near the stern
Some dulling and light chalkiness on the black Mercury cowling, most visible in the rear view
Light grime and staining on the white transom area around the motor mount
Interior only partly visible; seats and deck look reasonably tidy from what is shown
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lund 1875 Pro V. It already looks well kept, but there is some light spotting on the hull sides and the black Mercury cowling is starting to dull a bit in the rear shot. We do mobile pre-sale wash, wax and polish work and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
